what_it_was: AIService.chat built history as `priorTurns ?? (hasConversationId && storeHasChats ? [] : brain.getConversation().modelMessages())`. MemoryBridge.threadContext returned the same shared window whenever the request had no conversationId. Both were implicit: a fallback expressed as a `??` with a condition beside it.

replacement.contract: the only code that may return the brain's shared window

cases.input: unknown conversation id, no chats (first run)

replacement.trace: every non-conversation source records a TASK_CONTEXT entry with its reason

callers_audited.before: returned the shared window when the id was absent
callers_audited.after: builds the thread from the request's own turns; no id = no shared window
purges the conversation's session material and graph nodes

identity_resolution.missing_id: no history; memory is treated as historical, ownerless material

residual_risks: The brain's rolling window is still WRITTEN by every turn (it is the offline composer's working state). It is no longer READ for turn history; the adapter is the single reader and only on a true first run.
Headless callers that pass no conversation id now get no transcript history; that is the intended, explicit behaviour rather than a silent inheritance.
